title: Pre-commit Hook for Validation of .zenodo.json Files
description: This repository contains a pre-commit hook that validates `.zenodo.json` files against an unofficial Zenodo JSON Schema, derived from the InvenioRDM and Zenodo code bases using Claude Opus 5. It ensures that the metadata provided in `.zenodo.json` files is correct and adheres to the expected structure, helping maintain consistency and accuracy in software metadata submissions to Zenodo.
notes: The schema file check_zenodo_json/zenodo-derived-legacy-deposit.schema.json is licensed under CC0-1.0. The rest of the repository, and therefore this deposit as a whole, is licensed under Apache-2.0.
